subject: Focused improvement cadence and evidence collection for Mateo Alvarez
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-03T09:15:00Z
Subject: Focused improvement cadence and evidence collection for Mateo Alvarez

Hi Mateo —

Thanks for taking the time in last week's 1:1. I want to put the next steps in writing so we have a clear, measurable cadence for the next 6 weeks before we decide on next-level HR processes. This is intended as supportive — the goal is to get you back on track with the expectations for the role.

High-level plan (start week of Aug 3):
- Weekly 30-minute focused check-in with me (Wednesdays, 11:00am). Short agenda: blockers, concrete deliverables for the coming week, and two quality examples of work.
- Deliverable evidence: for each check-in, please attach at least one artifact (PR link, doc, or short demo clip) that demonstrates progress.
- Success metrics: reduce number of reopened reviews by 50% over 6 weeks, and meet SLA for priority bugs (<=48h).
- Midpoint review: after 3 weeks we'll do a 45-minute review including Monica to evaluate trajectory and adjust supports.

Attachments: mateo_performance_summary_2026Q2.xlsx (data-backed summary), initial_checkin_notes_2026-08-03.pdf (notes from today's discussion).

Immediate asks for you:
1) Confirm you can attend weekly Wednesday 11:00am check-ins.
2) Reply with any required support (pairing, time to spin up tasks, or tooling access).

I will track the artifacts and outcomes centrally and share with Monica. If you prefer a different time, propose alternatives by EOD.

Thanks — looking forward to making steady progress.

— Markus
Engineering Manager, Inference Platform
Redwood Inference

Thanks Markus — I appreciate the clarity and the supportive tone. I can make Wednesdays 11:00am work.

Quick clarifications:
- The reopened reviews metric — does that count only backend review cycles or frontend as well?
- For artifacts: would a short Loom demo + PR link be sufficient?

I was also hoping for some pairing time with Karthik on the caching work; that would help me avoid repeated rework.

I'll upload the first artifact (PR + brief notes) before Wednesday's check-in.

— Mateo

Thanks both. Markus — this is a reasonable, documented approach. Two small HR notes:

1) Please keep all artifacts in the Drive folder linked below and add a one-line summary to the shared tracker after each check-in (helps if we need to create formal records later).
2) I'll join the midpoint review unless you both prefer otherwise.
3) I've attached the improvement_template (redwood_improvement_template.docx) — use it if you'd like a formalized statement of expectations; not required at first.

Thanks for the clear plan and for documenting it. I'm supportive of the 6-week supportive window with a 3-week midpoint checkpoint. A few additions:

- Please ensure the artifacts are time-stamped and include short reviewer comments where possible (helps HR assess quality of change).
- Karthik, please schedule one 2-hour pairing/blocking session in week 1 to work through the caching design and reduce churn.
- If the midpoint does not show measurable improvement on the core metrics, escalate to Monica and me within 48 hours with the collected artifacts and a short manager narrative.

Markus — keep me posted after the first two check-ins; if I don't see progress by week 3 (midpoint) I'll join the review.

Marissa
